policy: antd-bridge.css may only shrink; every !important declaration and selector that reaches Ant Design internals must be covered by this registry

exceptions.scope: application shell and current user entry
exceptions.reason: application shell and user-entry migration compatibility
exceptions.exitCondition: shell, header and current-user styles are colocated and use component tokens

exceptions.reason: legacy authentication selectors still reach Ant Design component internals
exceptions.exitCondition: unused legacy auth selectors are deleted and retained styles move to the auth feature

exceptions.reason: member role cards still use bridge-owned Ant Card layout rules
exceptions.exitCondition: member role styles move to the members feature

exceptions.reason: shared panel and form wrappers still depend on bridge layout compatibility
exceptions.exitCondition: shared wrappers and feature forms own their styles without bridge overrides

exceptions.reason: desktop query grids still depend on bridge layout compatibility
exceptions.exitCondition: query areas use feature-owned or shared QueryBar layout

exceptions.scope: shared table, empty and detail wrappers
exceptions.reason: shared wrappers still reach Ant Design internal elements from the bridge
exceptions.exitCondition: shared wrappers own colocated styles and no longer require the bridge
